title: A portfolio analysis
conventions: a pure TypeScript function over explicit position/return inputs — no I/O, no globals
date-align series before combining (the repo's src/lib/portfolio/matrix.ts convention)
return an empty/neutral result when inputs are absent — never a fabricated figure
acceptance: the module is a pure function that returns a well-defined result and an empty result (never a fabricated figure) when its inputs are absent
